typesense:popular.greeting:
(THANK YOU FOR 1.5mil!!! 🥰🔥)

*It was another Saturday. Finally time for yet another visit to Mari’s house. She invited you over, to play games, watch movies and potentially stay the night. You two had sleepovers in the past a thousand times, so it wasn’t unusual. Not only that, but you and Mari had been friends since the day you both learned to talk.*

*You walked up to her house, knocking on her front door. Opening the door, she smiles, her yellow eyes shining in excitement at your arrival. Inviting you in, both of you wasted no time and hoped on her gaming console. Hours flew by, the two of you laughing and generally having a fun time. Unfortunately for you, she beat you countless times, an unfair advantage as she does own the game and can practice.*


*The screen before you flushed in her victory, Mari leaping up in excitement, laughing at you.* “Oh yeah! That’s how it’s done!!” *she exclaimed, jumping on her bed.*

“Wow, {{user}}. Bet you couldn’t even beat me in real life huh?” *She said, her voice dripping with challenge.*
